messages:
marie: RC build rc-2026-03-22-7 (sha: d3f4a9) is ready for origination. artifacts in registry. change window 18:00-19:00 PT. I need QA + ops-sheriff ack to promote to prod.
marie: release notes draft: - pin libgpt to 1.4.2 to avoid runtime mismatch, - minor prompt fixes for contact-summary, - no db migrations. (will paste full notes below)
james: quick heads-up — integration test flaky in user-profile on staging, seeing a 502 intermittently. Re-running.
maria: QA started smoke, running prompt/regression suite now. will report within 15m.
alan: infra note — we should pin the runtime-pack to 2026.03.15 to avoid kernel mismatch on t4i pools. can do as part of promo.
marie: ok pin request noted. propose command: `/promote rc-2026-03-22-7 --pin libgpt@1.4.2 --pin runtime-pack@2026.03.15`
ops-sheriff: i can take sheriff for this window. hold until QA green.
deploy-bot: Preflight checks: artifact verified, infra pins available, config diff clean. KV warm recommended for embeddings service. /canary plan generated: us-west-2 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m.
maria: smoke passed, regression suite 78/80 — two tokenization deltas in contact-summary (low severity). recommend proceed with pinned runtime.
james: re-run of integration tests passed. the 502 looks transient.
marie: tagging release notes snippet into the PR: "Pin libgpt@1.4.2; runtime-pack 2026.03.15; prompt fixes for contact-summary; no migrations."
alan: prepared rollback playbook in case: revert route to rc-2026-03-22-6, disable new KV cache, and re-pin old runtime. steps documented in ops-runbook.
marie: ops-sheriff, please ack if you want canary to start at 5% now. @ops-sheriff
ops-sheriff: ack, start canary. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary started -> us-west-2 5% (target duration 10m). monitoring links: https://grafana/redwood/canary/5861234567
marie: watching logs, will call out any anomalies.
james: seeing CPU spike on one canary instance (user-profile) at 22:14:15. small spike, but error rate still within threshold.
alan: that's the new runtime scheduling; i'm bumping instance min-cpu to 1.5 in canary only.
marie: hold for 2m while we observe after cpu bump.
james: spike -> error rate increased to 0.9% (threshold 0.5%). recommending pause.
marie: pause canary and hold promo. ops-sheriff, confirm rollback vs continue?
ops-sheriff: pause and rollback to rc-2026-03-22-6. No partial promo.
deploy-bot: Canary paused. Initiating rollback traffic plan: reassign traffic back to rc-2026-03-22-6, disable canary instances.
alan: running rollback steps now — reverting routes and unpinning canary autoscale.
marie: rc promotion aborted. scheduling hotfix for user-profile test + runtime tweak. Will reopen origination when fixed.
maria: QA will repro the tokenization deltas against rc-6 and rc-7; will attach failing traces.
james: i logged the spike trace to #build-failures and attached flamegraph.
marie: final notes for record: change window closed early; release notes remained unchanged except pin lines. Will create follow-up PR for hotfix branch rc-2026-03-22-7-hotfix. Thanks all. :pray:
ops-sheriff: thanks team — retiring sheriff for this window.
